issues.problem: Intro claimed musing なあ and prohibitive な share one image ('inside your own head'), which does not fit a ban aimed at a listener.
issues.action: Rewrote intro to present them as two separate jobs told apart by attachment and length.

issues.problem: Example translated 服 as 'this top'; 服 is clothes generally.
Explain implied の is the only casual question form; bare rising intonation (行く？) is equally normal.
issues.action: Added a one-line note that bare rising questions work and の adds 'what's going on?'.

issues.problem: Mistake marked 来週あるっけ？ as wrong, but bare dictionary form + っけ is common in casual native speech; explain overstated the んだ requirement.
issues.action: Softened explain (んだっけ is the safe form, bare form heard casually) and replaced the mistake with っけ wrongly used to wonder about unknown future weather (fix: かな).

issues.problem: Example 田中さん、明日来るんだっけ？ reads as addressing Tanaka, conflicting with the third-person English.
issues.action: Changed to 田中さんは明日来るんだっけ？ with 'Tanaka's coming tomorrow, right? I forget.'

issues.problem: Explain said 'never 行こうぞ', but 行こうぞ exists in period-drama/archaic speech.
issues.action: Changed to 'not 行こうぞ (period-drama only)'.
